# Optimal Taxation with Multiple Incomes and Types

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Kevin Spiritus, Étienne Lehmann, Sander Renes, Floris T. Zoutman  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Theoretical Economics  
**DOI:** [10.3982/TE5479](https://doi.org/10.3982/TE5479)  
**Publisher:** [https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.3982/TE5479](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.3982/TE5479)

**Keywords:** optimal taxation, multiple incomes, tax design, redistribution, public economics

## Abstract

Develops a theory of optimal taxation when individuals have multiple income sources and belong to multiple types, providing new insights into the design of tax systems that account for the multidimensional nature of individual earnings.
